en.headline: Chinese Culture Funfair at Tai Kwun ends Monday after four-day run
en.dek: The free event on the Parade Ground showcased work by more than 240 ambassadors from the Jockey Club programme, with workshops and cultural experiences open until 3 p.m. today.
body: The Chinese Culture Funfair, the closing event of the Jockey Club Exploring Chinese Culture Ambassador Programme, ends on Monday at Tai Kwun’s Parade Ground after a four-day run that began on 14 August.

Organised by Our Hong Kong Foundation and implemented by the Academy of Chinese Studies under the foundation, with funding from The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, the fair presented outcomes and works by more than 240 programme ambassadors.

Activities included hands-on workshops and a handicraft cultural experience zone covering Hanfu dressing, fan-making, Lu Ban Lock challenges and other traditional crafts. The organisers said the event was designed for families and parent-child participation.
Opening hours on the final day were 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Admission was free. Tai Kwun is at 10 Hollywood Road, Central.
The programme aims to deepen young people’s understanding of Chinese culture through training and public sharing.

zh.headline: 大館中華文化嘉年華今日結束 一連四日免費開放
zh.dek: 賽馬會中華文化大使計劃總結活動於大館操場舉行，展出逾240名大使成果，並設工作坊及傳統工藝體驗。
body: 「賽馬會中華文化大使計劃」總結活動「中華文化嘉年華」於大館操場舉行，由8月14日至今日一連四日，今日為最後一天，開放至下午3時。
活動由團結香港基金主辦、旗下中華學社執行，香港賽馬會慈善信託基金捐助，展出計劃逾240名大使的成果及優秀作品。
現場設有多項動手工作坊及傳統工藝體驗區，包括漢服體驗、扇面製作、魯班鎖挑戰等，適合家庭及親子參與。
最後一天開放時間為上午10時至下午3時，免費入場。大館位於中環荷李活道10號。
計劃旨在透過培訓及公開分享，加深年輕人對中華文化的認識。
